extension-build.description: Builds the Blender extension archives the project's blender_manifest.toml declares; a project holding pyproject.toml builds from a staged copy that bundles its local dependencies as subpackages and its locked registry dependencies as the wheels uv selects for each platform the manifest lists, one archive per platform

package.description: Packs the Adobe UXP plugin or CEP extension the project's other builds wrote, else its tracked source folder: a .ccx zip for a manifest.json, a .zxp ZXPSignCmd signs with a certificate it creates for the build for a CSXS/manifest.xml

install.description: Installs what the project's build wrote in the run's configuration where its host loads it: each package built for this platform through the host's own installer, or the unpacked build folder for a host loading one

release-publish.description: Attaches each host package the project's build wrote to its GitHub release, then publishes it to its host's store where one takes uploads, skipping a version the store holds, a version no release tag holds under nx release publish alone, and a project nx release left unversioned

unreal-build.description: Builds a .uproject's editor target through UnrealBuildTool, or packages a .uplugin through AutomationTool's BuildPlugin once per engine its hosts name and archives each package
